_note: Landing sites. lat = selenographic latitude (deg, north positive); lon_east = east longitude (deg). Every coordinate is copied from the cited page; 'source.text' is the text as printed there. Negative longitudes as printed in a source are stored as east longitude 0–360° (lon + 360). Group 'future' (added 15 Nov 2026, ADR 0042): south polar places named by NASA as candidate or target areas for later landings; each coordinate is a point the cited page gives inside that area, not a chosen landing point. Added 15 Nov 2026 (ADR 0105): four more regions from NASA's October 2024 list of nine Artemis III candidate landing regions; each region is about 15 km across and the listed point is one representative point a cited NASA, LROC, LPSC or journal source gives inside it.
